title: "JQI_PersonalSatisfaction_PersonalFinance_Race"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# JQI: Job Satisfaction, Financial Satisfaction, and Race
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

jqi_gss <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Construct variables
# ============================================================

race_satfin <- jqi_gss %>%
  mutate(

    # Job satisfaction
    job_satisfaction = case_when(
      as.numeric(satjob) == 1 ~ 4,
      as.numeric(satjob) == 2 ~ 3,
      as.numeric(satjob) == 3 ~ 2,
      as.numeric(satjob) == 4 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Personal financial satisfaction
    financial_satisfaction = case_when(
      as.numeric(satfin) == 1 ~ 3,
      as.numeric(satfin) == 2 ~ 2,
      as.numeric(satfin) == 3 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Race
    race_group = case_when(
      racecen1 == 1 ~ "White",
      racecen1 == 2 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    race_group = factor(
      race_group,
      levels = c("White", "Black")
    )

  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(job_satisfaction),
    !is.na(financial_satisfaction),
    !is.na(race_group),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Descriptive statistics
# ============================================================

race_satfin %>%
  count(race_group)

race_satfin %>%
  group_by(race_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_job_satisfaction =
      mean(job_satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_financial_satisfaction =
      mean(financial_satisfaction, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_compensation =
      mean(compensation, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_benefits =
      mean(benefits, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_earnings_stability =
      mean(earnings_stability, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Basic race × job satisfaction model
# ============================================================

m_satfin_job_race <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group,
  data = race_satfin
)

summary(m_satfin_job_race)


# ============================================================
# 5. Full model:
#    race × job satisfaction × JQI components
# ============================================================

m_satfin_job_race_jqi <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group +
    job_satisfaction * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
    race_group * compensation +
    race_group * benefits +
    race_group * earnings_stability +
    job_satisfaction * race_group * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * race_group * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * race_group * earnings_stability,
  data = race_satfin
)

summary(m_satfin_job_race_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 6. Joint test of racial differences in JQI moderation
# ============================================================

linearHypothesis(
  m_satfin_job_race_jqi,
  c(
    "job_satisfaction:race_groupBlack:compensation = 0",
    "job_satisfaction:race_groupBlack:benefits = 0",
    "job_satisfaction:race_groupBlack:earnings_stability = 0"
  )
)

m_satfin_job_race_comp <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * compensation +
    race_group * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * race_group,
  data = race_satfin
)

m_satfin_job_race_benefits <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * benefits +
    race_group * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * race_group,
  data = race_satfin
)

m_satfin_job_race_earnings <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
    race_group * earnings_stability +
    job_satisfaction * race_group,
  data = race_satfin
)

summary(m_satfin_job_race_comp)
summary(m_satfin_job_race_benefits)
summary(m_satfin_job_race_earnings)


linearHypothesis(
  m_satfin_job_race_jqi,
  c(
    "race_groupBlack:compensation = 0",
    "race_groupBlack:benefits = 0",
    "race_groupBlack:earnings_stability = 0"
  )
)

m_satfin_job_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group +
    job_satisfaction * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
    race_group * compensation +
    race_group * benefits +
    race_group * earnings_stability +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year),
  data = race_satfin
)

m_satfin_job_race_time_full <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * compensation * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * benefits * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    race_group * compensation * factor(year) +
    race_group * benefits * factor(year) +
    race_group * earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = race_satfin
)

anova(
  m_satfin_job_race_time_restricted,
  m_satfin_job_race_time_full
)

m_satfin_job_race_time_restricted <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group +
    job_satisfaction * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
    race_group * compensation +
    race_group * benefits +
    race_group * earnings_stability +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * factor(year) +
    race_group * factor(year),
  data = race_satfin
)

m_satfin_job_race_time_focused <- lm(
  financial_satisfaction ~
    job_satisfaction * race_group * factor(year) +
    job_satisfaction * compensation +
    job_satisfaction * benefits +
    job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
    race_group * compensation +
    race_group * benefits +
    race_group * earnings_stability +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = race_satfin
)

anova(
  m_satfin_job_race_time_restricted,
  m_satfin_job_race_time_focused
)

# ============================================================
# 7. Year-specific models
# ============================================================

yearly_satfin_job_race <- race_satfin %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    model <- lm(
      financial_satisfaction ~
        job_satisfaction * race_group +
        job_satisfaction * compensation +
        job_satisfaction * benefits +
        job_satisfaction * earnings_stability +
        race_group * compensation +
        race_group * benefits +
        race_group * earnings_stability +
        job_satisfaction * race_group * compensation +
        job_satisfaction * race_group * benefits +
        job_satisfaction * race_group * earnings_stability,
      data = .x
    )

    tidy(model)

  }) %>%
  ungroup()

yearly_satfin_job_race
# ============================================================
# 8. Save results
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  yearly_satfin_job_race,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_JobSatisfaction_PersonalFinance_Race_YearSpecific.csv"
  )
)
```
